startLead: Upload once. Slides and controls become ready while evidence is found in the background.
readyLead: Your slides are ready. Connect a public Stage and start whenever you are ready.
uploadLead: We will open the presenter workspace as soon as the slides are ready.
evidencePrepared: Showing evidence as it becomes ready.
audiencePopupBlocked: The browser could not open the audience screen.
audienceJoinTimeout: The audience screen has not responded yet.
audienceBindFailed: Could not connect the audience screen.
audienceOpensBeside: The audience screen opens beside this window.
connectLead: If you opened the audience screen on another device, paste its connection code here.
reportFinalizing: Ending the presentation and finalizing its report.
reportFinalizeFailed: The report could not be finalized.
reportLead: Only the presenter can review the presentation flow and derived aggregates.
reportPending: The report is not ready yet.
signInLead: Your setup, coaching, and team notes stay here. Nothing on this screen appears to the audience.
signInPrivacy: Your credentials are sent only to the server and are never stored by this browser.
signInFailed: We could not sign you in. Check your username and password.
signUpLead: After creating your account, you will sign in to the workspace with these credentials.
signUpUsernameRules: Use lowercase letters, numbers, periods, underscores, or hyphens. Enter 3-32 characters, starting and ending with a lowercase letter or number.
signUpPrivacy: Your sign-up details are sent only to the server and are never stored by this browser.
signUpUsernameTaken: That username is already in use. Choose another username.
signUpUsernameInvalid: Check the username format and try again.
signUpPasswordTooShort: Use at least 8 characters for your password.
signUpFailed: We could not create your account. Try again shortly.
liveApprovalLead: Nothing publishes automatically. Review every suggestion before it reaches the audience.
approvalNeedsDeck: Upload a presentation in the workspace first.
autoSuggestions: Suggestions for this presentation load automatically.
approvalInitial: Load a fresh authoritative snapshot before approval.
snapshotFailed: We could not load the latest suggestions. Try again.
liveApprovalFailed: Approval failed. Load the latest suggestions again.
published: Published. Load a new snapshot before another approval.
toolsReady: Your slides and presenter tools are ready below.
moveControl: Move presentation control to a separate device before continuing.
coResidentLead: The private presenter view and audience screen share this PC. Move control to a separate device before using Duplicate.
invalidCode: That connection code is not valid.
wrongPresentation: That screen belongs to a different presentation.
screenApproved: Audience screen approved. That window continues on its own.
connectControls: Connect the audience screen to enable controls.
slideChanged: The audience screen moved to the selected slide.
startedMessage: Presentation started. The audience screen is showing slide 1.
slidesPlaceholder: Slides will appear here after upload.
slideLoadFailed: The slide could not be loaded.
stageHandshakeWaiting: After you open the audience screen, its connection request appears here.
stagePairPending: The newly opened audience screen is asking to connect.
stageOpenBlocked: The audience screen window was blocked. Allow popups or use the other-device pairing below.
